headline.purpose: Default page heading; responsive and detail overrides remain component-local.

title.purpose: Recurring section headings; the focused commitment has a larger local treatment.

body.purpose: Native text at the root size with paragraph line-height, not a universal control line-height.

row-title.purpose: Compact queue title with medium weight.

label.purpose: Field help and short supporting labels.

metadata.purpose: Source and reason text below a work title.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The immediate primary action. Inset hover stroke and zero-offset focus keep the control in place.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 43px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--primary); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--on-primary); } .ds-primary:active { background: var(--primary-tint); color: var(--primary-on-tint); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: var(--subtext); background: var(--substrate); border-color: var(--border); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A neutral surfaced alternative with a persistent control boundary.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-secondary:active { background: var(--pressed); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: var(--subtext); background: var(--substrate); border-color: var(--border); }

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Visible secondary decisions without a filled surface at rest.
components.css: .ds-quiet { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--subtext); cursor: pointer; } .ds-quiet:hover { background: var(--hover); color: var(--text); } .ds-quiet:active { background: var(--pressed); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-quiet:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: var(--subtext); background: var(--substrate); border-color: var(--border); }

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Compact close control with a descriptive accessible name.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" type="button" aria-label="Close demo scenarios"><svg class="ds-icon-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 34px; min-width: 34px; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--subtext); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-svg { flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-icon:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-icon:active { background: var(--pressed); } .ds-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-icon:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; color: var(--subtext); background: var(--substrate); border-color: var(--border); }

components.name: Labeled text field
components.description: Native field with a visible label, reserved border, and a primary border shift on focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Next concrete step<input class="ds-input" value="Review the requested change" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); } .ds-input { flex-basis: 100%; width: 100%; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; background: var(--substrate); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--input-border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--subtext); } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--primary); }

components.name: Selected navigation
components.description: Neutral selection, a small primary marker, and an explicit current-page label.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: var(--substrate); } .ds-nav-item { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-start; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 10px 12px; gap: 12px; color: var(--subtext); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-nav-item:active { background: var(--pressed); } .ds-nav-item.ds-selected { background: var(--selected); color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } .ds-marker { width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-left: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary); } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav { flex-direction: row; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-nav-item { width: auto; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; min-height: 39px; padding: 8px 10px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-marker { display: none; } }

components.name: Supporting panel
components.description: The existing demo-panel treatment: neutral ground, a hairline boundary, and secondary explanatory text.
components.html:
Demo scenarios

Time moves forward only. No live sync, AI, or OS notifications.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text); background: var(--substrate); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 22px; margin-bottom: 30px; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -.015em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 7px 0 15px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--subtext); } @media (max-width: 460px) { .ds-panel { padding: 18px; } }

components.name: Work row
components.description: Compact work title and source/reason text, with a separate quiet Start control.
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-width: 0; min-height: 68px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; } .ds-row-body, .ds-row-action { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; line-height: 1.35; display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-row-body { text-align: left; display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; padding: 10px 4px; color: var(--text); } .ds-row-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row-meta { color: var(--subtext); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-row-action { padding: 7px 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--subtext); } .ds-row-body:hover, .ds-row-action:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-row-action:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-row-body:active, .ds-row-action:active { background: var(--pressed); } .ds-row-body:focus-visible, .ds-row-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 0; } @media (max-width: 460px) { .ds-work-row { gap: 9px; padding: 3px 0; } .ds-row-body { gap: 5px; } .ds-row-title { font-size: 13px; } .ds-row-action { padding-inline: 5px; font-size: 11px; } }

narrative.overview:
I document the implemented application's semantic projections, not a new visual identity. [Ultra Dusk](docs/theme.md), the supplied [Design System](docs/Design%20System.md), and [Cognitive Interface Model](docs/Cognitive%20Interface%20Model.md) remain the visual and interaction authorities. This document and its sidecar defer to them. The frontmatter records reusable implementation values; it does not replace, reinterpret, or extend the supplied Dusk palette.

I preserve the pinned world: lavender-cast neutral surfaces, warm text, native system sans, and fern on the primary control. Hierarchy comes from placement, space, type, and concise labels. Supporting information remains available without requiring attention at the same time.
keyCharacteristics: One primary thing on a calm neutral surface.
Native typography with scannable, short supporting text.
Restrained semantic accents and precomputed foreground pairings.
Visible, zero-offset focus and instant, non-moving control states.
Optional drill-in detail with clear paths back.

rules.name: The Neutral Area Rule
rules.body: Large surfaces stay neutral; small semantic accents identify actions and state. Color supplements labels, icons, and structure.

rules.name: The Paired Foreground Rule
rules.body: Use the supplied on-fill and on-tint pairings. Do not calculate new blends or add local fallback colors.

rules.name: The In-Place State Rule
rules.body: Control states are instant: no hover translation, scaling, padding change, or newly introduced layout border.

dos: **Do** defer to the supplied Dusk theme and interaction documents before extending this application projection.
**Do** keep large surfaces neutral and use semantic foreground pairings.
**Do** build hierarchy with native typography, spacing, labels, and restrained emphasis.
**Do** keep focus visible at zero offset and preserve control geometry across states.
**Do** keep supporting detail optional and provide a clear path back.
**Do** keep success brief and explicit, and failures diagnostic.
donts: **Don't** replace the pinned world with a new brand, webfont, or monospace interface.
**Don't** turn the focus workspace into a dense multipanel project dashboard.
**Don't** use full-window accent fills or color as the only state signal.
**Don't** add decorative motion, hover lift, or scaling.
**Don't** turn incidental measurements, unused tokens, or implementation defects into design rules.
**Don't** invent tonal ramps, service status, or external execution that the prototype does not supply.
